title: Hy Baba Teri Ummat Nai Meray Ronay Tai Pehray Laayai
body:
Main Dasdi Haan Teray Bajaun Teri Zahra Nai Jo Zulm Uthayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mimbar Day Saamnay Teri Sanad Day Purzay
Chundi Rahi Naal Surndi Rahi Galan Teri Tehreer Day Baray
Hy Mimbar Day Saamnay,main Rondi Rayi Oh Hasday Rahay
Jina Lokan Nu Tu Kalmay Parhayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq Lairn Gayin Saan Zalim Diyan Jhirkaan
Dhaldi Rahi Saath Maldi Rahi Roo Kay Khari Darbaar Vich Aakay
Hy Haq Lairn Gayin Saan,main Ujri Nu Na Haq Milaiya
Koyi Main Vangun Darbaar Na Jayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Dhi Day Naal Jo Ehna Kalma Gohaan Nay
Keeti Aai Haath Paasay Tay Rakh Kay Sairn Hurn Dheek Vi Rovay
Hy Teri Dhi Day Naal Jo,kisay Sochaiya Na Aai Zahra Aai
Ais Ujri Tay Kyun Taagh Girayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Nu Keeta Zainab Day Havaalay
Umbri Nay Kaar Kay Pyaar Akheeri Eh Kun Gal Naal Chalaya
Hy Shabbir Nu Keeta,naalay Kehndi Rahi Sang Choreen Na
Meray Bachray Tay Koyi Waqt Vi Aayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehchaan Vi Bhul Gaye Teri Bachri Di Baba
Main Haan Zahra Ladli Paak Nabhi Di Meray Ghaar Nu Jalaao
Hy Pehchaan Vi Bhul Gayi,teray Naaleh Kay Baba Sayeen
Ohna Lokan Kay Main Vastay Paayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain Kun Sadaiya Jadon Aakhari Vailay
Zahra Nay Hovay Ronday Howay Pay Gayay Aakay Umbri Dai Sarhanay
Hy Hasnain Kun Sadaiya,ruh Jismil Chon Pervaaz Keeti
Hy Puttar Jadon Gaal Naal Si Laayai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hasnain Di Umbri Nay Jo Likhaiya Eh Noha
Akhtar Nay Vasta Awn Di Maa Da Karay Bakshish Da Waseela
Hy Hasnain Di Umbri,haar Momin Layee Tera Naa Leh Kay
Taboot Uttay Jinay Athru Vaghaayai.
